subject: general
question: ‘Kadambari’ is written by
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banabhatt.**__

 
• The creator of 'Kadambari' Banabhatta was a great scholar.
 
• He composed Harshavardhana's biography Harshacharita.
 
• It is the world's first biography, written as a novel.
 
• Banabhatta has the same position in Sanskrit prose as Kalidasa in Sanskrit poetry.
